metadata.description: House standards for eisensoftware.com applications: design tokens and UI styles, hexagonal architecture, and deployment, image and site conventions with one generated skill per registered site.

plugins.name: eisen-design
plugins.description: Design foundation: the design-token contract (neutral tokens.css + contrast checker), information architecture, WCAG 2.2 AA accessibility with an axe audit script, and five swappable ui-style-* skills with mockups.

plugins.name: eisen-architecture
plugins.description: Architecture standards: hexagonal layout with runnable Python and TypeScript checkers, ports-and-adapters rules with templates, and agent-friendly codebase conventions (AGENTS.md, gates, plans, worker packets).

plugins.name: eisen-platform
plugins.description: Deployment standards: semver releases with receipts (deploy-versioning), immutable image tags on Artifact Registry (image-tagging), how an app joins eisensoftware.com (site-plugin), and one generated site-<id> skill per registered app.
